To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a safe and comfortable take over request should be done by the vehicle by giving the driver enough time to take over control of the vehicle, by giving the driver a clear understanding of what the vehicle is doing at that moment in time and by providing the driver with a clear and understandable feedback on the driver’s actions.
a driver should be informed of a take over request as early as possible and as detailed as possible in order to give the driver enough time to take over control of the vehicle.

a TOR should be triggered when the driver is not able to take over the vehicle, the TOR phase should be designed such that the driver is given the opportunity to regain control of the vehicle, and the driver should be given the opportunity to continue automated driving after the TOR phase.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following aspects: 1.
the driver take over phase of autonomous driving.
the driver take over process, the driver take over strategy, the TOR phase, the driver take back process, the TOR end phase, and the driver take back strategy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the driver is not a passenger in an automated driving vehicle, but a co-pilot.
a TOR is a critical part of an automated driving system and needs to be treated as such.
the TOR should be a smooth and comfortable transition for the driver.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the automated driving system must be prepared to handle a TOR at any time.
an appropriate TOR should not be a surprise for the driver, and the automated driving system needs to give the driver sufficient time to take back manual control of the system.
a safe TOR can only be achieved if the TOR request is given early enough and if the TOR request can be anticipated by the driver.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TOR should be initiated as soon as the automated system detects a TOR event and that the driver should be given enough time to take over control of the vehicle.
an early TOR is preferred over a late TOR in order to allow the driver to regain control of the vehicle in a timely manner.
a driver take over should be requested as early as possible, and that the automated driving system needs to support the driver in order to make the TOR as easy and comfortable as possible.
